04 THE THINKING PROCESS

Every insight starts
with a better question.

A simple framework for moving
from information to understanding.

01 /
?

Ask the right question.

Start with the problem. Understand the context and define what a useful answer would look like.

02 /
≋

Make sense of the data.

Bring structure to the information. Check its quality, explore patterns, and follow the evidence.

03 /
↗

Make the insight useful.

Connect the findings to the question. Tell a clear story and show what deserves a closer look.
